operations.description: ENGINE_GAP: getRecord's recordId is a QUERY parameter ("passed as a query parameter to support special characters", per the API's own docs), not a path segment; engine.WriteAction has no query field at all (write.go's ExecuteWrite always calls Requester.Do/DoForm with a nil query), so a single-record-by-id lookup keyed by a query-param id cannot be expressed as either a read stream path or (see below) a write action in this dialect
